_readme: Public sketches and poems for the Creative page. Sketch: id, title (person's name or a description), note, date (ISO), image (path under img/sketches/). Poem: id, title, body (line breaks preserved), date. Files saved from the admin panel stay in that browser only; entries here are visible to everyone.
disclaimer: Sketched by self, smoothened by AI.

sketches.title: Adele
sketches.note: Graphite portrait study. Winged eyeliner, fingers resting on the cheek, the gaze drifting off to the right.

sketches.title: Amber Heard
sketches.note: Charcoal study, looking back over the shoulder with hair caught in the wind and a hard shadow across the face.

sketches.title: Madhubala
sketches.note: Pencil portrait of the Hindi cinema icon. Bindi, drop earring and the sideways smile from the golden age of Bombay film.

sketches.title: Sherlock
sketches.note: Pencil study of Benedict Cumberbatch as Sherlock Holmes. Eyes closed, collar open, mid-deduction.
